title: SupplierCollectionBatchEnvelope
description: Cross-runtime handoff contract: a Node.js collector emits one envelope per supplier query batch; the Python importer consumes it. Re-submission of the same batch_id must be treated as a duplicate and never re-imported; retries must use a new batch_id.

contract_version.description: Contract version emitted by the collector. The importer rejects any other version.

batch_id.description: Unique batch identifier assigned by the collector. The pipeline uses it for idempotent, exactly-once ingestion.

supplier.description: Supplier identifier the batch was collected from.

queried_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the supplier portal was queried.

part_number.description: Queried material / part number as typed into the supplier portal.

brand.description: Optional brand filter used in the query.

results.description: Raw per-row results in portal order. An empty array is a valid, explicitly empty batch.

notes.description: Optional free-form collector note (e.g. simulation marker).

status.description: Per-row outcome: 'ok' carries a raw supplier part, 'error' carries a structured extraction failure. A batch mixing both is a partial failure.

part.description: Raw supplier part payload. Required when status is 'ok'.

error.description: Structured failure detail. Required when status is 'error'.
